documentation.content: Symptom: a Cloud Run revision failed during container startup. Logs: https://console.cloud.google.com/run/detail/us-central1/sedaia-api/logs?project=sedaia-web-platform-api-508804. First checks: inspect the failing revision's startup, port, health, and configuration errors. Roll back before shifting traffic when the new revision cannot become ready. Owner: __NOTIFICATION_OWNER__.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/sedaia_api_startup_failures" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="sedaia-api" AND resource.label.location="us-central1"
